description: Managed daily facility operations, safety compliance, and urgent issues while finishing a full-time Master's degree.

positions.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer (Freelance)
description: Set up GitHub Actions workflows to push code directly to cPanel hosting, creating a reliable deployment process where none existed before.
Created a Git branch workflow (main, dev, feature) and a staging environment to safely test updates before releasing them to users.
Resolved DNS conflicts between Cloudflare and cPanel nameservers to bring the website back online and prevent downtime.
Updated web layouts for mobile screens, compressed image files, and used Docker to standardize local development setups.

positions.title: Founder & Infrastructure Engineer
description: Provisioned and managed full AWS infrastructure using Terraform including ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, ALB, Route 53, ACM, and ECR. All infrastructure defined as code with zero manual configuration.
Built and operated CI/CD pipeline with AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild, delivering zero-downtime container deployments to ECS on every release.
Configured Docker containerisation across all services, managing image builds, ECR pushes, and container orchestration on ECS Fargate.
Monitored production system health using CloudWatch dashboards and alarms, responding to and resolving infrastructure issues to maintain platform availability.

positions.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer

Managed local and staging databases, updated environment variables, and tested API endpoints to ensure system stability.
